tasks.label: Demo: full pipeline (transcripts → improved prompt)
tasks.detail: End-to-end. Builds the context graph, then lets the LLM improve the .raven prompt. Uses the local Claude Code CLI — no API key needed.

tasks.label: Improve THIS prompt (the file I have open)
tasks.detail: Runs the improver on whichever .raven / prompt file is open in the editor. Reuses the existing context graph, so it takes ~10s plus model time. Your file is copied first and never modified.

tasks.label: Improve a prompt (ask me for the path)
tasks.detail: Prompts for a path to any prompt file, anywhere on disk, then improves it.

tasks.label: Demo: context graph only
tasks.detail: Stage 1 alone — transcripts to flow chart, report, per-turn capture, glossary. No LLM.

tasks.label: Demo: improve prompt only
tasks.detail: Stage 2 alone — assumes the context graph is already built.
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; cp data/clients/abcl/autorun/input.raven data/clients/abcl/demo/demo.raven && python run_improve.py data/clients/abcl/demo/demo.raven --client abcl --auto

tasks.label: Demo: show last diff
tasks.detail: The before/after patch from the most recent demo run.

inputs.description: Path to the prompt file to improve
